flags.reason: misreads-source: The part is marked alwaysPresent=true, but the same anatomy line says to "Use None when the surrounding owner already supplies that edge." The configuration section offers "Padding · Default / None", so the HStack's own inset is optional, not always present.

misreads-source: The example uses a `Badge` component. Nothing cited supports it: the evidence lists the public exports as Button, HStack, VStack, Stack, Icon and Text, plus the action-guide components, and Badge is not among them. The guide's live examples show only text labels ("Paid | Due today | New").
misreads-source: Same problem: it builds the wrapped row from `Badge` children. The evidence does not list Badge as a public export of jfs-components@0.1.60, so nothing cited supports using it.

notes: /configuration/7 is tagged [required] and targets value=center. It is a package fact, and the item states its condition ("To match Figma's Alignment Left"), so it was not flagged. A human should confirm the pack doesn't read it as "always set alignVertical to center"; the default is flex-start (Top Left). In /examples/2, Padding: 'None' is also passed in the modes of each Text child. That is redundant given that children inherit mode context, but it is not a misreading. Also check whether Badge exists in the package types before the Badge flags are acted on.
